verdict.rationale: Multi-currency billing is a fair question for a billing platform, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions local-currency invoicing, per-currency price points, or converting reporting into a home currency. The revenue analytics item covers custom dashboards and CSV export, not currency consolidation, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency
